/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Six moulded panels in orange, green, red, navy, yellow and sky blue make up the Abstract Climber, set in two rows between grey steel posts. Each panel is cut through with irregular openings, so children pick their own route up, across and down, using the gaps as hand and foot holds. Working out a route builds grip, balance and problem-solving, and the wall can be climbed from either face. The product area is 5'8" x 9'4", and its safe play area of 10'8" x 14'4" lets it sit beside a slide or swing in a school ground. Colour is listed as Multi Color. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates on this climber carry a 3-year warranty. Send us your site photos and we will prepare a layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: Abstract Climber stands on galvanised steel posts that are grouted or installed self-standing, depending on your ground. Children climb on both faces, so keep the full 10'8" x 14'4" zone clear and lay rubber flooring at the base on both sides. Check the panel bolts and post fixings at each maintenance visit.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Three low beams make up this set, each a rounded rail on short legs, in teal, yellow and red. Laid out at different angles, they give children a path to walk heel to toe, step from one beam to the next and hold their arms out for balance. Because the beams sit close to the ground, younger children can try them alongside older ones, and teachers can use them for simple balance drills during games periods. The product area is 2'9" x 12'11", and the safe play area is 7'9" x 17'11". It is listed as Multi Color. Our 3-year warranty applies to the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates. Ask us to fit the Balancing Beam into your layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: Each beam stands on short legs that are grouted or installed self-standing. Set the three beams on level ground with rubber flooring or another soft surface around them, inside the 7'9" x 17'11" zone. Check the leg fixings during routine maintenance and keep the beam tops clean, as mud or algae after rain makes them slippery.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Balancing Bridge is a long, low crossing of round stepping pads in blue and orange, hung between steel end frames. A hand rope runs above the pads, and a short ladder at the end helps children get on. As they cross, the pads move under their feet, so they learn to shift their weight, hold the rope and steady themselves. At 24'2" x 2'11" it is long and narrow, which makes it a good link between two parts of a playground or a run along a boundary. The safe play area is 29'2" x 7'11". Colours are Play Orange and Knight Blue. A 3-year warranty covers its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Share your site plan and we will place it on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The pads are linked and suspended, so the links holding them take most of the wear. Inspect them and the hand rope at every service, and tighten the end-frame fixings. The frames are grouted or installed self-standing. Keep the 29'2" x 7'11" zone clear and lay rubber flooring under the full length of the bridge.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Crawling through a tube and popping out at the far end is one of the first games small children invent, and the Crawling Tunnel is built around it. A ribbed tube in orange and baby blue runs between two shaped end panels, held up by grey posts at the corners. The tunnel sits just off the ground, so children crawl in on hands and knees, turn around inside or meet a friend coming the other way. It builds core strength and body awareness, and it makes a natural hideout in a game of chase. The product area is 8'10" x 4'6", with a safe play area of 13'10" x 9'6". Colours are Play Orange and Baby Blue. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates are under 3-year warranty. Ask us for a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The tube and end panels are fixed to galvanised posts, which are grouted or installed self-standing. Rainwater can collect inside a tunnel, so check that it drains and wipe it out after heavy showers. Keep both openings clear within the 13'10" x 9'6" zone, and look inside for insects, nests or litter during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: The Crest Climber is an overhead ladder with an upright ladder at each end, finished in Play Red and Play Yellow. Children climb up one side, swing hand over hand along the rungs and climb down the other, or simply hang and drop. Moving along the bars builds grip, arm and shoulder strength, so it suits children who can already hold their own weight. Its 10'10" x 4'8" footprint is compact, and the safe play area is 15'10" x 7'8". Our Droopy Climber offers the same kind of play in Horizon Teal with a bird figure on top. On the Crest Climber, galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope come with 3 years of warranty. Send us your site details for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: Both ladders and the overhead frame are galvanised pipe, grouted or installed self-standing as your ground allows. Children drop from the bars, so the surface underneath matters most. Lay rubber flooring under the full length, keep the 15'10" x 7'8" zone clear and check the rungs for loose joints at each service.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Five coloured discs hang on chains from a steel frame, just above the ground, and the Disc Challenger asks children to cross from one to the next without stepping down. Each disc swings as it takes weight, so children hold the chains, shift their feet and plan the next step before they make it. It is a short challenge course in a footprint of 6'6" x 3', with a safe play area of 11'6" x 8', so it fits into a gap on an existing playground. Teachers can use it for turn-taking games and simple races. Colour is listed as Multi Color. The 3-year warranty on this unit covers galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. We can show it on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The hanging discs swing all the time, so their chains and top fixings need checking at every maintenance visit, with worn parts replaced promptly. The steel frame is grouted or installed self-standing. Lay rubber flooring under the discs and keep the 11'6" x 8' zone clear, as the discs swing outward when children step off.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: A red bird perched on the top bar gives the Droopy Climber its character. Below it, a teal overhead ladder with triangular hand grips spans two upright frames, each with a ladder for getting up and down. Children grab the triangles one after another to move across, which builds grip and upper-body strength, and the bird gives younger ones something to point at and talk about. The product area is 11'2" x 3', narrow enough for the side of a society garden, and the safe play area is 16'2" x 8'. It is finished in Horizon Teal. Its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope are covered by our 3-year warranty. For a red and yellow option, see the Crest Climber, or ask us for a layout and quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: Galvanised uprights carry the overhead ladder and are grouted or installed self-standing to suit the soil. Check the hand grips and the fixing of the bird figure at each service visit. Rubber flooring under the full run of grips is the right surface, because children will drop from the bars. Keep the 16'2" x 8' zone free of benches.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Hopping Pod is a line of five round pods on single posts, stepping up and down in height along the row, in green, mustard, navy, yellow and red. Children step or hop from pod to pod, judging distance and height each time, which trains balance, leg strength and timing. The product area is only 7' x 1', with a safe play area of 12' x 6'. It fits along a path edge, beside a sandpit or between bigger pieces in a play area. Parents and teachers often turn it into a counting game, with each hop called out loud. Colour is listed as Multi Color. We give 3 years of warranty on galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us to place it on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: Each pod sits on a single post grouted into the ground or fixed self-standing on a firm base. Pod tops get slippery when wet, so keep them clean and check the textured surface during maintenance. Lay rubber flooring between and around the pods, and keep the 12' x 6' zone clear of edges and kerbs.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Jumping Jacks is a cluster of round bounce pads, each mounted on a coil spring above a square base plate. The pads come in navy, orange, red and sky blue, and they give slightly under a child's weight, so children bounce, balance and jump from one pad to another. Spread across an open patch, the pads become stepping stones in a game of floor-is-lava or a chase between friends. The listed product area is 9'4" x 4', with a safe play area of 14'4" x 9'. Colour is listed as Multi Color. Galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts have 3-year cover, and the springs carry 1 year under our standard warranty terms. Ask us to lay the pads out on your site drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: Each spring is bolted to a base plate that is grouted or fixed self-standing to a firm surface. Springs are the wearing part here, so check them for cracks, rust and pinch gaps at every service. Lay rubber flooring between the pads and keep the 14'4" x 9' zone clear so jumping children do not land on hard edges.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Leo Climber is a long yellow caterpillar of steel hoops with a rope net stretched over its back, rising into tall humps and dipping low between them. Children crawl along the net, climb over each hump and come down at the far end, while a yellow ladder partway along gives another way on and off. Climbing the net builds strength, coordination and confidence with height. Its product area is 54' x 18'10" and the safe play area is 59' x 23'10". It needs a long, open strip of ground, such as the edge of a large park or a school field. It is finished in Play Yellow. Under our warranty, galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope are covered for 3 years. Share your site plan so we can check the fit.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The net is play rope fixed to galvanised hoops, and each hoop leg is grouted or installed self-standing. A climber this long needs a level strip, so we check the ground along its full length first. Inspect the net knots and fixings at every service, and lay rubber flooring under the tall humps where children climb highest.
